failure_summary.description: The answer was substantively correct but differed in granularity or form: expanded names or roles, an omitted honorific, or mismatched noun number/article.
The agent selected an association matching only part of the clue instead of following evidence or the answer category that fit the full clue.
The agent repeated a clue modifier rather than inferring the missing headword in a compound phrase.

patch.reasoning: The skill already advises concise answers and matching the full clue, so the patch avoids restating those general rules. It adds guidance for using explicit answer-key forms, preserving required grammatical or conventional name forms, and resolving clues whose answer is an implied headword.

edits.content:
## Calibrate Answer Form and Complete Clues
When context includes an explicit answer-key or Q&A entry for the same clue, use its answer wording and scope rather than expanding it with a role or fuller name. Otherwise, preserve the conventional form required by the clue or context, including established honorifics, and match common-noun number and necessary articles. For terse wordplay or definition clues, infer the implied headword or conventional compound from the whole clue and its parallel examples; do not echo a quoted modifier or select an example that matches only one keyword.
